This is about Spring Cloud Data Flow (based on the user stories mentioning Mesos SPI, Rabbit binder, YARN deployer, SHDP, SI (Spring Integration), Kafka bus, Boot upgrades, composed jobs with HSQL DB). I need to create a WBS-based effort estimation. Let me break down each user story into development activities:

U1: Add "undeployed" status for Mesos SPI — small change: add enum value, wire it in state machine, tests. Estimate ~1-2 days.

U2: REST API to clean Rabbit binder broker artifacts — port/restore REST endpoint invoking RabbitBindingCleaner: controller, service wiring, tests, docs. ~3-4 days.

U3: Optimize YARN deployer for rapid deployment of stream and modules — more complex: analyze performance, caching of app artifacts, parallel deploys, tests. ~5 days.

U4: Upgrade to SHDP 2.2.1 GA — dependency upgrade, version alignment (Spring, Hadoop versions), regression testing. ~3 days.

U5: Upgrade to Spring Integration 4.2.2 GA — dependency upgrade, regression testing. ~1-2 days.

U6: Set partitioning key for Kafka bus even with single downstream module — modify binding properties handling, producer partitioning config, tests, docs. ~3 days.

U7: Upgrade Boot and Spring Cloud Build revisions — pom updates, fix incompatibilities, regression tests. ~2 days.

U8: Document HSQL DB limitations with composed jobs — documentation only. ~0.5-1 day.

Plus cross-cutting activities: overall integration, CI, release notes, project management? 3. A3 (U3): YARN deployer optimization: profiling, design caching/parallelization, implementation, perf tests. 5 days.
4. A4 (U4): SHDP 2.2.1 GA upgrade: update dependency versions, resolve API changes, regression tests on HDP/CDH. 3 days.

7. A7 (U7): Boot & Spring Cloud Build upgrade: pom updates, fix deprecations, full build/tests. 2 days.
8. A8 (U8): HSQL DB composed jobs documentation: 1 day.
9. A9: Increment-level integration testing & CI stabilization: 2 days.
10. A10: Release documentation/release notes & final verification: 1 day.

Total: 2+4+5+3+2+3+2+1+2+1 = 25 days.

technical_and_design_decisions: Baseline stack: this increment targets the Spring Cloud Data Flow 1.x-era codebase (Spring Boot 1.3, Spring Integration 4.2.x, Spring Hadoop/SHDP 2.2.x) on Java 8; the generic Spring Framework 6/Java 17 note in the overview text does not apply to these stories.

U1: Add an UNDEPLOYED value to the Mesos deployer SPI deployment-state enum and map the 'application not currently deployed' condition to it instead of UNKNOWN, keeping existing state transitions unchanged.

U2: Expose the existing RabbitBindingCleaner through a new secured REST endpoint following current admin API conventions (controller delegates to the cleaner component; returns per-binding cleanup results; consistent error handling and HTTP status codes).

U3: Optimize the YARN deployer by caching application artifacts/contexts to avoid repeated HDFS uploads and by parallelizing module deployment requests for a stream definition; keep the public deployer SPI contract unchanged.

U4/U5/U7: Perform dependency upgrades via Maven parent/BOM version changes only (SHDP 2.2.1 GA, Spring Integration 4.2.2 GA, Boot and Spring Cloud Build revisions); align Spring/Hadoop/Hive transitive versions and fix only compilation/deprecation fallout, preserving backward compatibility.

U6: Extend the Kafka bus/binder producer configuration so a partitioning key (expression) can be set even when there is a single downstream module, delegating to Kafka native partitioning and preserving per-key message ordering; expose it via the existing bus properties mechanism.

U8: Document HSQL DB limitations for composed jobs in the existing Asciidoc reference documentation (in-memory, single-instance, non-production usage and concurrency/transaction caveats); no code changes.
All changes delivered with JUnit unit tests and, where applicable, integration tests on the existing CI pipeline; no new tooling or frameworks introduced.
assumptions: One developer (the estimator) performs all work; estimates are pure effort in workdays and exclude calendar waiting such as CI queue delays.
The existing codebase already contains the Mesos deployer SPI, YARN deployer, Kafka and Rabbit bus/binder modules, and the RabbitBindingCleaner component ported from XD.
Test environments (RabbitMQ broker, Kafka cluster, YARN/HDP/CDH test cluster) are already available; environment provisioning effort is negligible and included where relevant.
Point-release dependency upgrades (U4, U5, U7) are drop-in with no intentional breaking API changes; only minor compilation/deprecation fixes are expected and are included in the estimates.
Documentation work uses the existing Asciidoc reference docs; no new documentation infrastructure is needed.
Estimates include unit/integration testing and documentation updates per story, but exclude formal external code review since development is performed solo.
The REST cleanup endpoint for U2 follows existing admin API security and does not require new authentication/authorization mechanisms.

activities.activity_name: U3: YARN deployer performance analysis and design

Implement artifact/context caching and parallel module deployment in the YARN deployer while preserving the deployer SPI contract.
Validate deployment-time improvement on a YARN test cluster and add/adjust tests guarding the optimized behavior.
Update dependency versions to SHDP 2.2.1 GA, align Spring/Hadoop/Hive versions per its backported improvements, and resolve compilation/deprecation issues.

activities.activity_description: Bump SI version to 4.2.2 GA and run the affected integration test suites to verify no regressions.

activities.activity_description: Add tests verifying partition assignment and per-key ordering with a single downstream module, and document the new property.

activities.activity_description: Update Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Build versions in the build, fix resulting build/deprecation issues, and verify the full build passes.

activities.activity_description: Write reference documentation describing HSQL DB limitations (in-memory, single-instance, non-production, concurrency caveats) when used with composed jobs.

activities.activity_description: Run the combined test suites across all changed modules together, fix cross-story integration issues, and stabilize CI.
